title: Competitive Comedy @ Neighborhood Comedy Theatre
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: The duration of the show is approximately 90 minutes with some variation
Seats are first come, first serve
Please have your confirmation voucher available upon arrival
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join the most hilarious comedians Phoenix has to offer at this interactive, 90-minute comedy show at the Neighborhood Comedy Theatre.  Shout out suggestions during a wholly unique improv show that changes every time.  You will be doubled over in laughter and laughing through tears in no time.
